title: Railway Station Master & RRB NTPC Careers: Selection Stages, CBAT Psycho Test, Pay & Free Resources
summary: Complete preparation guide for Indian Railways Non-Technical Popular Categories (RRB NTPC). In-depth breakdown of CBT-1 & CBT-2 patterns, CBAT psycho battery tests for Station Master, A-2 medical visual standards, 7th CPC salary, and free mock test portals.
author: Sarkari Aavedan Editorial Team
content:
## Introduction & Career Overview

The Railway Recruitment Boards (**RRB**) conduct the Non-Technical Popular Categories (**NTPC**) examination to recruit over 35,000+ graduate and undergraduate professionals into the operational backbone of Indian Railways. Among all positions, the **Station Master (Pay Level-6)** and **Goods Train Manager (formerly Goods Guard - Pay Level-5)** are the most sought-after executive roles, responsible for safe train movements, signaling coordination, and station administration across 17 Railway Zones.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> For the post of **Station Master**, final merit is calculated with **70% weightage to CBT-2** and **30% weightage to the Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT / Psycho Test)**. Clearing all 5 CBAT test batteries with minimum T-score is mandatory!

## RRB NTPC Post Hierarchy & Pay Scales (7th CPC)

| Post Name | Minimum Qualification | Pay Matrix Level | Entry Basic Pay | Approx In-Hand Salary (X-City) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Station Master (SM)** | Bachelor's Degree in any stream | **Level-6** | ₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400 | ₹60,000 – ₹68,000 / month (Plus Night Duty Allowance) |
| **Goods Train Manager (Goods Guard)** | Bachelor's Degree in any stream | **Level-5** | ₹29,200 – ₹92,300 | ₹58,000 – ₹72,000 / month (Includes Running Kilometre Allowance) |
| **Senior Commercial cum Ticket Clerk** | Bachelor's Degree in any stream | **Level-5** | ₹29,200 – ₹92,300 | ₹48,000 – ₹54,000 / month |
| **Senior Clerk cum Typist** | Bachelor's Degree + Typing Skill | **Level-5** | ₹29,200 – ₹92,300 | ₹48,000 – ₹54,000 / month |
| **Commercial cum Ticket Clerk** | 12th (10+2) with min 50% marks | **Level-3** | ₹21,700 – ₹69,100 | ₹35,000 – ₹40,000 / month |
| **Junior Clerk cum Typist** | 12th (10+2) with min 50% marks | **Level-2** | ₹19,900 – ₹63,200 | ₹32,000 – ₹36,000 / month |
| **Accounts Clerk cum Typist** | 12th (10+2) with min 50% marks | **Level-2** | ₹19,900 – ₹63,200 | ₹32,000 – ₹36,000 / month |

## Step-by-Step Selection Procedure for Station Master

1. Apply online via the central Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) apply portal (rrbapply.gov.in).
2. Appear for CBT-1 (1st Stage Computer Based Test) — common screening test for all NTPC posts (Qualifying in nature).
3. Qualify the CBT-1 cutoff to appear for CBT-2 (2nd Stage Computer Based Test) specifically for Level-6 posts.
4. Shortlisted candidates (8 times the vacancies) undergo the Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT / Psycho Test).
5. Undergo Document Verification (DV) based on combined scores of CBT-2 (70%) and CBAT (30%).
6. Pass the strict Railway A-2 Medical Examination at Railway Divisional Hospitals before final appointment.

## CBT-1 Examination Pattern (Screening Stage)

CBT-1 is a 90-minute online screening test comprising 100 objective questions for 100 marks. There is **1/3rd negative marking** for every incorrect response.

| Subject / Section | Questions | Marks | Mark Weightage Graph | Core Focus Areas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **General Awareness (Current, Science & GK)** | 40 Questions | 40 Marks | [BAR:40%:General Awareness] | Everyday General Science (Physics, Chem, Bio), Indian Railway History, Current Events, Geography |
| **Mathematics (Arithmetic & Basic Algebra)** | 30 Questions | 30 Marks | [BAR:30%:Mathematics] | Number System, Decimals, Fractions, LCM/HCF, Ratio, Percentages, Time & Work, Speed & Distance |
| **General Intelligence and Reasoning** | 30 Questions | 30 Marks | [BAR:30%:Reasoning] | Analogies, Number & Alphabetical Series, Coding-Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Blood Relations |
| **Grand Total (CBT-1)** | **100 Questions** | **100 Marks** | **[BAR:100%:Total Test]** | **Composite Time: 90 Minutes (120 mins for PwBD with scribe)** |

## CBT-2 Examination Pattern (Merit Deciding Stage)

CBT-2 is conducted separately for each 7th CPC Pay Level. For Station Master (Level-6), the test comprises 120 questions for 120 marks in 90 minutes with 1/3rd negative marking.

| Subject / Section | Questions | Marks | Mark Weightage Graph | Syllabus & Difficulty Standard |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **General Awareness** | 50 Questions | 50 Marks | [BAR:41.7%:General Awareness] | High depth: Science & Technology, Indian Constitution, Environmental Issues, Static GK, Railway Budgets |
| **Mathematics** | 35 Questions | 35 Marks | [BAR:29.2%:Mathematics] | Advanced Arithmetic, Elementary Statistics, Simple & Compound Interest, Mensuration, Geometry |
| **General Intelligence & Reasoning** | 35 Questions | 35 Marks | [BAR:29.2%:Reasoning] | Syllogisms, Venn Diagrams, Puzzle Sitting Arrangements, Statement & Conclusions, Decision Making |
| **Grand Total (CBT-2)** | **120 Questions** | **120 Marks** | **[BAR:100%:Total Test]** | **Composite Time: 90 Minutes (Strict Sectional Timing: None)** |

> [!TIP]  
> **The General Awareness Decider**: In CBT-2, General Awareness carries a massive **50 out of 120 marks (41.7%)**! Aspirants who score 38+ in GA almost universally secure top ranks and their desired Railway Zone.

## CBAT (Psycho Aptitude Test) — The 5 Battery Tests

To qualify for Station Master, candidates must score at least **42 T-Score points in each of the 5 test batteries** independently. There is no negative marking in CBAT.

| Test Battery | Evaluated Cognitive Skill | Testing Mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| **Battery 1: Intelligence Test** | Non-Verbal Classification | Identifying the odd figure out of 5 abstract visual patterns in high-speed time constraints. |
| **Battery 2: Selective Attention Test** | Rapid Odd Number Addition | Adding only odd numbers (1, 3, 5, 7, 9) in rapid rows of digits while ignoring even numbers. |
| **Battery 3: Spatial Scanning Test** | Shortest Route Finding | Navigating railway track grid maps between designated stations without touching red obstacles. |
| **Battery 4: Information Ordering Test** | System Process Control | Calculating final values of switches, level gauges, and dials through input-output logic matrices. |
| **Battery 5: Personality Assessment Test** | Emotional Stability & Safety | Answering 35 psychological personality questions testing decision-making and railway passenger safety commitment. |

## Mandatory A-2 Medical Fitness Standards

> [!WARNING]  
> Station Masters control track points and signaling. Indian Railways enforces strict **A-2 Medical Classification**:  
> - **Distant Vision**: 6/9, 6/9 without glasses (NO glasses or surgical correction like LASIK is permitted!).  
> - **Near Vision**: Sn. 0.6, 0.6 without glasses.  
> - **Color Vision & Night Vision**: Must pass Ishihara 38-plate color blindness test, binocular vision test, and field of vision tests. Candidates with color blindness are disqualified.
